entries.title: My degree path, and what it isn't
entries.text: Completed: B.Sc. Computer Science (Honours) under West Bengal State University, 2021–2024, then MCA (Master of Computer Applications) at Jadavpur University, 2024–2026. That's the whole list so far. It was B.Sc. then MCA — not a BCA, and I never did an M.Sc.; I chose the MCA over one. I don't hold an M.Tech or a PhD and I'm not enrolled in either. Next: GATE 2028 for an M.Tech at an institute with good research scope, with an MS by Research as the alternative if the lab is the right one. An MS by Research, or MS(R), is the thesis-based research master's at IITs and IISc — it is not an M.Sc. Further out: a PhD or research role abroad, on reasoning models.

entries.title: B.Sc. semester-wise SGPA and CGPA
entries.text: B.Sc. Computer Science (Honours), West Bengal State University, CBCS, six semesters, 140 credits. SGPA by semester: Sem 1 — 10.00 (20 credits); Sem 2 — 10.00 (20); Sem 3 — 9.77 (26); Sem 4 — 9.77 (26); Sem 5 — 10.00 (24); Sem 6 — 10.00 (24). Final CGPA 9.91 out of 10, which WBSU's conversion rule puts at 88.65%, and 1st rank in Computer Science across WBSU. Every semester cleared first time with no back papers. Most papers are theory plus practical marked together out of 75; an O (grade point 10) needs 60 of 75. The two 9.77 semesters each had a single A+ (9) — Physics in Sem 3 and DBMS in Sem 4. Every other paper was an O.

entries.title: MCA semester-wise SGPA and CGPA
entries.text: MCA at Jadavpur University, CSE department, two years and four semesters, 74 credits. SGPA by semester: Sem 1 — 8.33 (21 credits, Feb–Mar 2025); Sem 2 — 8.57 (23 credits, Apr–May 2025); Sem 3 — 8.68 (22 credits, Dec 2025); Sem 4 — 10.00 (8 credits, Apr–May 2026, seminar and project). It went up every semester. Final CGPA 8.90 out of 10, with JU weighting all four SGPAs equally; weighted average 81.76% and First Class. Every semester passed first time, and the bridge course was waived. JU grade cards give letter grades, not marks. Grade points: S = 10, A = 9, B = 8, C = 7, D = 6. Theory papers carry 3 credits, labs 2.
